name: cuba-political-backend
description: Backend escalable para plataforma de noticias políticas de Cuba con pipeline de ingesta automática

scripts.ingest:full: node -e "const pipeline = require('./services/ingestionPipeline'); pipeline.runFullPipeline().then(r => console.log(r)).catch(e => console.error(e))"
scripts.ingest:sources: node -e "const pipeline = require('./services/ingestionPipeline'); pipeline.runIngestionOnly().then(r => console.log(r)).catch(e => console.error(e))"
scripts.ingest:summarize: node -e "const pipeline = require('./services/ingestionPipeline'); pipeline.runSummarizationOnly(200).then(r => console.log(r)).catch(e => console.error(e))"
